prompt: GNU make LOADLIBES variable relationship LDLIBS
answer:
`LOADLIBES` is a deprecated but still supported alternative to `LDLIBS`. GNU make’s implicit link rules include both variables, in this order:

```make
... $^ $(LOADLIBES) $(LDLIBS) -o $@
```

Use `LDLIBS` for library flags or names such as `-lm` or `-lfoo`; use `LDFLAGS` for non-library linker flags such as `-L...`. New makefiles should generally use `LDLIBS` rather than `LOADLIBES`.

Source: [GNU make implicit-rule example](https://ao2.it/en/blog/2011/11/27/dont-mix-ldflags-and-ldlibs), [Stack Overflow summary](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/17052006/make-ldlibs-deprecated).
